title: mrower's Hammer
description: hammer to quickly chop down those trees
body:
This mod adds hammers, which is useful for chopping down trees quickly. It chops down your trees with ease in a blow. In other aspects such as mining or PvP, don't even try, it's too heavy to swing with easily.

Current mod content: (might add more later)
- Wooden Hammer (1x1, cuts only logs)
- Ironclad Hammer (3x3)
- Forged Netherite Hammer (5x5)

Here you can see how big that is
![Visualization of the breaking boxes. Wooden hammer breaks in a 1x1, Iron 3x3, Netherite 5x5](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6882b347b3d942f19b74ea3079f9dfe335b178d7.png)

You can upgrade to the Forged Netherite Hammer by putting it in the smithing table along with a Netherite Ingot and Netherite Upgrade Template. Then you forge it and ta-da
